g.text: Flush tangent slat seats and five attachment holes; dashed curve is the ideal reflector.
Each rib: 162.5 x 297.4 mm; overlay width: 263.0 mm
Blue = rib A; orange = mirrored rib B; translucent fill shows overlap.
Five colored paths: original source above the pipe, five right-side reflection points.
33.4 mm OD pipe / 34.4 mm cradle bore
60 mm mounting pad plus curved gusset
Per half: 3 pad holes 9/32 inch; 5 slat holes 3/16 inch
8 mm cradle wall; inner bore remains 34.4 mm
Smooth 22 mm rib back stands proud of slat tails
Concept 24 - 12 inch reflector arc per side, cradle intersection to rib tip. Dimensions in mm.
